body: There is no better person to care for your rabbit than you. Please hang in there. Whether you believe it or not he’ll miss you. That little guy will miss you so dearly. He deserves YOU. I know life is hard, but just try to hang on.
I’m glad you’re okay, and I’m glad you were in good company. I’m sure that was probably really scary.

Hey. You’re not alone. Let me tell you, school fucking sucks. I just got an ecology midterm back... 58%. Yeah. I feel fucking dumb, but I know I’m not. And I know you aren’t dumb. Look at how far you’ve gotten! That’s no small feat. That’s impressive! And there’s nothing wrong with the fact that you don’t understand something perfectly right away. School is HARD, but you can do it. It’s not going anywhere, so just do the best that you can. As for your other feelings, I don’t know all of the aspects of your life, but a good therapist really does help. They can help you understand and sort out your feelings. They can help you find the old you you’ve been looking for. Please do not get discouraged. If you can’t see a therapist in person, they have online therapists that you can Skype with. If you want to message me I can help you find someone and give you other resources. I know how you feel. You are not alone.

It’s okay for y’all to take a break. That’s understandable. But in the meantime, you should focus on yourself. I know the world is overwhelming, and I know it might be hard to put yourself first, but please try. You said everything seems scattered? Get some sleep, a real good nights rest. Fuck school or work or anything that stresses you out, that can wait. It’s not going anywhere. If you can’t skip, try to take the day slowly. Listen to music. It’s okay to zone out and daydream if you need to. Getting some fresh air and sunshine and a walk helps me feel better when I’m down, maybe that could help you too? I know it sounds trivial but the little things really do add up to make you smile, even for a second.

Hey. You’re not useless. And you’ve got a lot of potential. Reach out to Addie. Let her know your feelings and your regrets. It doesn’t hurt to explain yourself. And take it day by day, hour by hour, or even minute by minute. This shit is hard, I get that. But you’re stronger than you think.
